name: Ultralight White Oak Slats, Black Felt
summary: Oak veneer in a white oak finish, laminated onto 9 mm recycled acoustic felt with a black backing. The panel has no MDF or other rigid core.

texture.note: Manufacturer specifications override photo estimates: seven 1.20 in slat faces on a 1.69 in pitch, 0.49 in wide 90-degree V-grooves cut 6.2 mm into coreless felt, and 0.35 in total depth; these inch components total 11.83 in versus the listed 11.80 in nominal panel width. The tile is seven pitches wide and 23.66 in tall, with procedural wrapping oak grain and oak/black-felt colors sampled from the main listing photo.
